fields.postcondition: the options instance exposes deterministic default backing-store keys, grain-key validation enabled, ApplicationServices initialization ordering, and any supplied query definitions indexed by GrainType
fields.response: initialize DatabaseKey = 'Common' (on OrleansDbPersistenceOptions) or ShardSetKey = 'Default' (on OrleansShardPersistenceOptions), ValidateGrainKeys = true, Queries = new Dictionary<string, OrleansQueryDefinitions>(), and InitStage = ServiceLifecycleStage.ApplicationServices, and populate Queries keyed by definition.GrainType when constructed with a non-null List<OrleansQueryDefinitions>
fields.subject: OrleansDbPersistenceOptions and OrleansShardPersistenceOptions
fields.trigger: an options instance is constructed with the parameterless constructor or a List<OrleansQueryDefinitions>
